dialogue.content: （こんばんは、時間になりましたら始めますので宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. We'll start when the time comes. Thank you for being here.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you, and likewise.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。まずは年齢・性別、話したい事を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 12歳、男、学校でイジメられてる。
dialogue.English: I'm 12, male. I'm being bullied at school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。今は何学年ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What grade are you in now?

dialogue.content: 小学6年です。
dialogue.English: I'm in the 6th grade of elementary school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: いじめにあっていてつらいよね。
dialogue.English: It's really tough being bullied, isn't it?

dialogue.content: うん、つらい
dialogue.English: Yeah, it's tough.

dialogue.content: いきたくない、もういやだ
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school. I'm sick of it.

dialogue.content: うんうん。だよね。学校にもいきたくないんだね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, I hear you. You don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: うん、いきたくない
dialogue.English: Yeah, I don't want to go.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、どんあいじめにあってるのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. What kind of bullying are you experiencing?

dialogue.content: (誤字どんな）
dialogue.English: (Sorry—typo. I meant “どんな” [what kind of].)

dialogue.content: 悪口いわれたり、ぼくの持ち物をかくされたり、たたかれたりする
dialogue.English: They call me names, hide my belongings, and hit me.

dialogue.content: うんうん。そんなひどい目にあってるんだね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. You've been going through such terrible things.

dialogue.content: だれも助けてくれない
dialogue.English: No one helps me.

dialogue.content: いじめて来るのは一人なのかな？
dialogue.English: Is it just one person bullying you?

dialogue.content: 2人いる
dialogue.English: There are two of them.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、いじめにあっているけど誰も助けてくれないだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're being bullied, but no one is helping you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: つらいよね、、、
dialogue.English: That must be so hard...

dialogue.content: 学校を休みたい
dialogue.English: I want to stay home from school.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないないほどつらいんだね。でも今は我慢していってるんだね。
dialogue.English: It's so tough that you don't want to go to school. But you're still enduring it and going.

dialogue.content: うん、がまんして行ってる
dialogue.English: Yeah, I'm forcing myself to go.

dialogue.content: えらいね。これからどうしたらいいのか一緒に考えていかないかな？
dialogue.English: That's admirable. Shall we think together about what to do from here?

dialogue.content: うん、そうしたい。
dialogue.English: Yeah, I'd like that.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お母さんや先生には、いじめにあってること話せるかな？
dialogue.English: Do you feel able to tell your mother or your teacher that you're being bullied?

dialogue.content: お母さんには言いたくない。心配かけるから。先生は、僕の話を聞いてくれるかわからない。
dialogue.English: I don't want to tell my mom because it'll worry her. And I'm not sure if my teacher will listen to me.

dialogue.content: 優しいんだね。先生には話せると思うかな？
dialogue.English: That's very kind of you. Do you think you might be able to talk to your teacher?

dialogue.content: 話せるかもしれない。だけどいつ話せばいいかわからない
dialogue.English: I might be able to. But I don't know when I should talk to them.

dialogue.content: 聞いてくれるか分からないってあるけど、先生には何かあるのかな？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're not sure they'll listen—do you have any particular concerns about your teacher?

dialogue.content: 先生が敵か味方かわからないから
dialogue.English: Because I don't know if the teacher is on my side or not.

dialogue.content: ありがとう、そうなんだね、何で、そう思うのかな？
dialogue.English: Thank you. I see. What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 先生も信じれない。イジメてくるやつと仲良いから
dialogue.English: I can't trust the teacher either. Because they're friendly with the bullies.

dialogue.content: そうなだね、学校にはカウンセラーさんはいないかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Is there a school counselor at your school?

dialogue.content: 1人いる
dialogue.English: There's one.

dialogue.content: いるんだね、その人には話せそうかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think you'd be able to talk with them?

dialogue.content: 話せると思う
dialogue.English: I think I can.

dialogue.content: 良かった。勇気を出してはなしてみようか？
dialogue.English: That's great. How about gathering your courage and trying to talk to them?

dialogue.content: だれかについてきてほしい。1人だと心配
dialogue.English: I want someone to come with me. I'm worried about going alone.

dialogue.content: なかのいい、友達とかはいる？
dialogue.English: Do you have any close friends?

dialogue.content: ちがうクラスにいる
dialogue.English: I do, but they're in another class.

dialogue.content: ちがうクラスなんだね、放課後とかにその友達とはなしに行こうか？
dialogue.English: I see, they're in another class. How about you and your friend go talk to the counselor after school?

dialogue.content: 一緒にきてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: Do you think they'd come with me?

dialogue.content: うんうん。大丈夫だと思うよ。
dialogue.English: Mhmm. I think it'll be okay.

dialogue.content: わかった、明日友達に話してみる
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll try talking to my friend tomorrow.

dialogue.content: うん。いじめにあってることも悩みを友達に話して見てね。
dialogue.English: Yes. Try talking to your friend about your worries and the bullying.

dialogue.content: わかった、言ってみる
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll try telling them.

dialogue.content: うん、頑張っていじめしてくるやつを退治しようか。
dialogue.English: Yes, let's do our best and take down those bullies.

dialogue.content: うん、やっつけたい！がんばってみる！
dialogue.English: Yeah, I want to beat them! I'll try my best!

dialogue.content: そうだね！
dialogue.English: That's right!

dialogue.content: もしうまくいかないみたいならまた相談来れるかな？
dialogue.English: If it doesn't seem to go well, can you come back to talk again?

dialogue.content: わかった！なんかちがうことがあったら、また相談にくる
dialogue.English: Okay! If something else happens, I'll come back to talk.

dialogue.content: うんうん。なんでもいいからつらいことがあったら来てね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. Whatever it is, if anything is hard, please come back.

dialogue.content: ありがとう少し勇気が出てきた！
dialogue.English: Thank you. I feel a little braver now!

dialogue.content: 良かった。応援してるから頑張ってね！
dialogue.English: I'm glad. I'm rooting for you, so do your best!

dialogue.content: うん、がんばる！
dialogue.English: Yeah, I'll do my best!

dialogue.content: 他には悩みはないかな？
dialogue.English: Do you have any other worries?

dialogue.content: お母さんにはいわなくていいよね？
dialogue.English: It's okay if I don't tell my mom, right?

dialogue.content: いじめだよね、勇気を出していおうか。
dialogue.English: It's about the bullying, right? How about gathering your courage and telling her?

dialogue.content: わかった、ちょっと言ってみる
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll try to tell her.

dialogue.content: うんうん。お母さんならしっかりと聞いてくれると思うよ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. I think your mom will listen carefully.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとう、私も元気になれました。ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. You've given me encouragement as well. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。がんばる！
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll do my best!

dialogue.content: うん、応援してるからね！
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, I'm rooting for you!

dialogue.content: ありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日は時間だから終わりにするけど何かあったら教えてね！
dialogue.English: We're out of time for today, so we'll end here, but please let me know if anything comes up.

dialogue.content: わかった
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. This was a valuable learning experience.)

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。こちらこそ勉強になりました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time. Thank you. It was a valuable learning experience for me as well.

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (I'll be taking my leave now.)
